emergent.summary: The daily calendar TRIGGER is chosen but not wired — the last open piece of OS-067
emergent.why: The app side is BUILT and tested (migration 026, meridian/calendar_context.py, scripts/calendar_context_ingest.py) and the connector is no longer orphaned: calendar now goes through Composio as its only adapter, by owner decision. Nothing may describe calendar as being polled until that is decided. Honest liveness already exists: the store reports the newest observed event and reads STALE rather than healthy when the feed stalls.

emergent.summary: A pre-existing ruff I001 in app.py is unfixed on purpose
